WITH failed_invoices AS (
    SELECT 
        account_id,
        invoice_date AS failure_date
    FROM invoices
    WHERE status = 'failed'
),
events_before_failure AS (
    SELECT 
        e.account_id,
        e.event_type,
        e.feature_name,
        e.occurred_at,
        fi.failure_date,
        fi.failure_date - e.occurred_at AS days_before_failure
    FROM events e
    INNER JOIN failed_invoices fi ON e.account_id = fi.account_id

)
SELECT 
    feature_name,
    event_type,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS affected_accounts,
    ROUND(AVG(days_before_failure), 1) AS avg_days_before_failure
FROM events_before_failure
GROUP BY feature_name, event_type
ORDER BY event_count DESC
